packetaCod.title: Packeta — COD
packetaCod.summary: Packeta costs are internal carrier costs. Customer COD price is the amount charged by Green Angels to the customer for COD.
packetaCod.distinctionHelp: Packeta costs are internal carrier costs. Customer COD price is the amount charged by Green Angels to the customer for COD.
packetaCod.packetaCostsHelp: Internal carrier costs charged to Green Angels — never shown as customer prices.
packetaCod.carrierCostEnable: Enable Packeta COD service cost tiers
packetaCod.carrierCostBasisHelp: Tier basis: COD amount (cash collected). Not product subtotal.
packetaCod.carrierCostNet: Packeta COD cost amounts entered as NET
packetaCod.cardOnCodHelp: Packeta charges this fee to Green Angels when the recipient pays the COD amount by card. This fee is an internal carrier cost and is not automatically added to the customer's order.
packetaCod.cardOnCodInformational: Informational only — not added to checkout total
packetaCod.customerPriceHelp: These values affect checkout and order total.
packetaCod.modeNoneHelp: When none, legacy cart COD fallback may apply if still stored.
packetaCod.feeBaseHelp: This determines which amount is used to select the COD price tier.
packetaCod.netHelp: VAT will be calculated according to the tax regime of the order (SK / OSS / reverse charge where applicable).
packetaCod.grossHelp: The entered amount already includes VAT. VAT will not be added again.
packetaCod.coverageHint: Compare customer fee vs Packeta base COD cost in the costs section (card-on-COD % is not included — unknown until recipient pays).
packetaCod.tiersEmpty: No tiers yet — enter contractual values manually. Do not invent amounts.

packetaSurcharge.insuranceHelp: Tiers on declared goods value only (not delivery, packaging, or COD). Leave disabled until contract tiers are entered.
packetaSurcharge.maxDeclaredValueHelp: If goods value exceeds this, the service is unavailable — highest tier is not used silently.
packetaSurcharge.tiersEmpty: No tiers — enter contractual values manually.
packetaSurcharge.nonDepotHelp: Packeta fee for handing packages in outside a depot. Amount is added to delivery cost; the storefront shows a single Delivery line.
packetaSurcharge.countryMethodsHelp: Controls which pickup/courier buttons appear at checkout for this destination. Independent of the global Cart method list.
packetaSurcharge.serviceCodHelp: Country COD rules override the general Packeta tab. If customer price is not overridden, the global “B. Customer COD price” applies.
packetaSurcharge.customerPriceOverrideHelp: Inherit = general Packeta settings. Otherwise overrides only for this country/method.
packetaSurcharge.carrierCodCostHelp: Internal accounting only: what Packeta charges the shop. Never added to checkout or shown to the customer.

flexiAutoSync.title: ABRA Flexi synchronization
flexiAutoSync.description: Automatic sync receives ABRA notifications and pulls the current state. Order export from the site to ABRA continues regardless of this switch.
flexiAutoSync.updateAllConfirm: Update all data from ABRA (catalog, prices, stock, active orders)? This is an authoritative current-state refresh.
flexiAutoSync.disableConfirm: Disable automatic sync? The webhook will be removed from ABRA. Order export will continue.
flexiAutoSync.enableDialogTitle: While automatic sync was off, data in ABRA may have changed.
flexiAutoSync.enableWithoutUpdateConfirm: Enable without update? Changes during the pause will not be caught up — only new notifications from now on.
flexiAutoSync.hookDeleteConfirm: Delete ABRA hook #{id}? Auto Sync and baseline stay unchanged.
flexiAutoSync.hooksDeleteOrphansWarn: Only hooks whose URL does not match configured webhookUrl will be deleted. The current production hook (if any) is kept.
flexiAutoSync.hooksOrphansNeedUrl: Save webhookUrl first — otherwise CURRENT cannot be determined.
flexiAutoSync.hooksDeleteAllWarn: All registered webhooks for this company will be deleted in ABRA. This stops webhook delivery for every integration using these hooks.
flexiAutoSync.hooksDeleteAllNote: No new hook is created after deletion. Re-enable Auto Sync via “Enable without update” or “Update and enable”.
flexiAutoSync.apiUsageHint: Counts REST calls made by this site to ABRA. Actual ABRA license usage may be higher if other integrations call the API.
flexiAutoSync.apiLimit: Local daily limit reached or exceeded
flexiAutoSync.legacyWarning: These are records from the old sync system. The new sync does not use them.
flexiAutoSync.legacyDeleteConfirm:
This will permanently delete {count} FlexiChangeEvent rows. These old-system sync records will not be processed or restored.

After deletion, manually run “Update all data from ABRA”.
flexiAutoSync.legacyClearedHint: Now run “Update all data from ABRA” to refresh catalog, prices, and stock.
flexiAutoSync.legacyClearedOrdersHint: If needed, also run “Refresh order statuses from ABRA”.
